keywords: Provincial High Court appeal – Breach of peace – Buddhist temple – Magistrate prohibiting Viharadhipathi from entering temple and later from entering area – Preventive jurisdiction – Scope of Magistrate’s powers – Section 81 permits order to show cause why bond should not be executed – Section 87 permits execution of bond – Criminal Procedure Code does not empower Magistrate to dispossess person from property merely to prevent breach of peace – High Court revision challenged. H.C.J. Madawala J. sat on the bench.
legistation: Code of Criminal Procedure Act No. 15 of 1979 – sections 81 and 87; Provincial High Court appellate/revisionary jurisdiction.
